controls.name: fold-every-error
controls.why: execute folds every error into an empty result (no _is_no_data check at :361)
controls.find: Chain::Fail(e) => if is_no_data(e) { Res::Done { rs: false, rowcount: no_data_rowcount() } } else { Res::Raised },
controls.replace: Chain::Fail(e) => Res::Done { rs: false, rowcount: no_data_rowcount() },

controls.name: ignore-cause
controls.why: _is_no_data reads only the error's own SQLCODE, not its cause's (:196): the three-path RuntimeError carrying SQLCODE 100 raises

controls.name: inline-none-not-folded
controls.why: execute does not treat a missing result of a DML statement as no-row (:365-366 removed)

controls.name: no-data-rowcount-unknown
controls.why: a no-row statement reports row count -1 instead of 0 (:373)

controls.name: batch-raises-on-no-data
controls.why: the batch's first pass does not fold SQLCODE 100 (_no_data_ok removed at :395-397): a no-row row stops the batch
controls.find:
Chain::Fail(e) => if is_no_data(e) { Chain::Got { rs: false } } else { Chain::Fail(e) },
        g => g,

controls.name: repair-fallback-resumes
controls.why: repaired variant: the fallback resumes at the row that failed instead of the first; the as-built rerun witness must then fail
